prompts.BLINK: Edit this exact photo. Keep everything identical: same {species}, same face, fur, mouth, head position, framing, lighting and background. Only change: the eyes are gently closed, as in the middle of a natural blink. Natural photo.
prompts._notes: Muse content filter (400 content_policy_violation) trips on 'fangs', 'canines', 'bared', 'hiss' and big-open-mouth cat prompts. Keep 'talking / softly meowing / calm, friendly'. Cats: if J2/J3 is filtered, retry once with the cat override prompt.
prompts.AH: Edit this exact photo. Keep everything identical: the same {species}, same fur, markings, eyes, nose, whiskers, ears, head position and tilt, framing, lighting and background. The nose, upper lip, whiskers and eyes do not move at all. Only change: the {species} is talking, its lower jaw lowered halfway: mouth half open, the tongue stays inside the mouth with only a little of its tip visible behind the small lower front teeth, dark pink inside of the mouth. Only the lower jaw and chin move down. Natural unretouched photo.
prompts.AH2: Edit this exact photo. Keep everything identical: the same {species}, same fur, markings, eyes, nose, whiskers, ears, head position and tilt, framing, lighting and background. The nose, upper lip, whiskers and eyes do not move at all. Only change: the {species} is talking with its lower jaw lowered halfway: mouth clearly open, the tongue lying low and flat on the floor of the mouth and mostly hidden behind the lower teeth, small white lower teeth visible, dark pink inside of the mouth. Only the lower jaw and chin move down. Natural unretouched photo.

secondary._units: px at 540 px frame width; cheek = [down, out] at full opening; brow lift on stressed onsets (op > .6 and rise > .25 within 3 frames, ≥0.6 s apart, profile [.5,1,1,.7,.4,.15]); nose lifts with jaw + idle sniff [.6,1,.4,.8,.3] every 2.2–4 s

cat_override._when: species is a cat (or the J3 prompt is filtered): a single open key, small openings drawn by flow only

prompts.AH2: Edit this exact photo. Keep the same cat, same fur, markings, eyes, nose, whiskers, head position, framing, lighting and background. The nose and the split upper lip under it stay exactly where they are. Only change: the cat is meowing, its small mouth open a bit wider, the rounded lower jaw lowered, pink inner mouth and the pink tongue resting inside the mouth visible, upper lip shape unchanged. Calm, sweet, natural photo.

prep._interior: BGR floor for pitch-black mouth interiors: dark pixels in a mouth ellipse blended toward max(px, colour), weight (1.4*mean(colour) - L)/(1.4*mean) * 0.85

prompts._neutral: neutral = the scene image (closed mouth line); SM/WD/OO/EE are edits of it

character2d._sizes: small SM / medium WD (0.62x, loud A >= 2 frames) / wide EE (0.87x, loud EI); base width = max(mouth box, 0.08 x head)

_fields.neutralFlow: when the snap shows neutral, scale its flow warp (0 = untouched neutral texture)
_fields.shownFloor: min geometry amount of the shown key (a shown key is never pulled back toward neutral below this)
_fields.snapMin: amount at which a key colour is shown (snap dissolve minAmount)

toy_override._when: plush / stuffed toy / figurine without an anatomical jaw (classify character_style == 'toy')

prompts.AH: Edit this exact photo of a plush toy. Keep everything identical: same toy, fabric, fur, nose, embroidered details, eyes, pose, framing, lighting and background. Only change: the embroidered mouth line opens slightly into a small felt fabric mouth opening with dark brown felt inside and stitched edges, no lips, no tongue, in the same plush toy style.

animal._ref: flags of B-lane render.py motion v2 (human v18/v19); nonhuman copy = nonhuman/render_h.py + runh.py; texMin = key amount at which its texture shows (human hard-codes 0.3)
animal._keys: jaw keys renamed for the v2 ladder: J2→AH, J3→AH2 (cat C2→AH2); fallback OH/O/EH/EI/U/WQ/MID/CDG/TH/L → AH, so the lip shape barely changes between vowels

lipShape._: corner blobs (σx .6·hw, σy .5·hw, hw = max(mouth half-width, .06 face width)) moved ±x by px × syllable jaw curve; EI/EH spread, O/U round; 5-frame box smoothing

chinWarp._: dy = px × jaw × smoothstep((y − (lowerLip − .02fh)) / .06fh) × exp(−max(0, y − lowerLip − .06fh)² / 2(.16fh)²) × exp(−(x − mcx)² / 2(.2fw)²); content moves down (sample at y − dy)

smallMouth._shade: faceflow --shade: darken the centre of the opening (cat 0.5, rabbit 0.35)

character3d._ref: flags of B-lane render.py motion v2 (human v18/v19); nonhuman copy = nonhuman/render_h.py + runh.py; texMin = key amount at which its texture shows (human hard-codes 0.3)
character3d._bigKeys: pixar-like: amp [0.25, 0.45], lip 0.78, texMin 0.15, cheek {spread .9, pull .6, cheek 1.2, naso .35, lift 3.0}

toy._ref: flags of B-lane render.py motion v2 (human v18/v19); nonhuman copy = nonhuman/render_h.py + runh.py; texMin = key amount at which its texture shows (human hard-codes 0.3)
toy._lipmask: human lipmask finds lips by redness; felt mouths are brown -> hull empty -> key never shown. Off for toys.
toy.keys2: AH (prep squash 1.05) + AH2 = same Muse image, prep squash 1.4 → stressed vowels open taller

character2d.driver: coart timing (one shape per syllable, vowel = syllable nucleus, stress = vowel loudness top 30 % / bottom 40 %)

human._ref: B-lane render.py --motion v2, sweep row v33; flags proto/tools/v33.flags + --cornerref 3.36

cheek._pull: per face: pull = clip(1 - cornerRef / mean key corner flow (px per 356-px face height), 0, .8)

expression._spec: sweep/README.md 'Expression layer' (smile, smileopen, laugh, surprised, concerned)

human.teethFadeMask: bright low-sat pixels inside lip hull minus lips only (never skin)

_keyNames: animal keys use the human names AH (half open) / AH2 (open); cat: AH2 only
_motionV2: app field names (L4): written by prep into face.flow.map.motionV2; values = render.py v22 flags used offline (--spring, --amp a:b, --lip, --idle, --jaw a:r:k, --preemph, --antic). texMin = render.py --texmin.
